backends.name: walbolge
backends.notes: walbolge.trace/tables/decoder/decompiler use no subprocess, socket, ctypes, cffi, mmap, eval or exec of specimen content; only specimen-file reads and report writes. Host-effect seam structurally absent.

backends.name: malbolge-engine
backends.notes: The C VM (vm.c/malbolge.c) exposes no host operation to the specimen. The *harness* launches malbolge-ipc.exe as a host process (declared HOST_PROCESS_START present), but no specimen can reach or exercise it. Cross-interpreter parity harness wired (M1).
